summary: Add Slop Score: can you tell your own Threads posts from AI slop? Five of your posts from the last 30 days meet five plain-AI twins on the same topics (each labelled AI twin · plain Claude, no context), shuffled with a stored seed and swiped blind one at a time, human or slop. The reveal shows your hit rate and a Slop Score from 0 to 100 for every card with the exact flagged words, using Unslop's unchanged scorer and its four tells (hedging, AI phrases, corporate voice, over-formatting), and the average for your posts against the AI twins. Threadify then writes the worst twin's topic from your Brain with the same prompt, only lowercased under a casing guard and re-scored the same way (slop NN -> NN), and schedules it with an Auto Plug from your existing offer (100 to 250 characters, ending with its plain link) after one yes, with a readback and how to undo it.
